ds.description: Channel Talk's open-source product design system and component implementation. It is retained as official product-system context, not used to overwrite current public marketing tokens.

tokens.note: Five current first-party surfaces. Marketing and product-doc domains are intentionally separate. Legacy universal Cobalt, BildV5, generic form, synthetic state, and inferred motion claims are not promoted.
